OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page

## Summary

I added optional `email` support to owners across the create (`POST /api/owners`) and update (`PUT /api/owners/{ownerId}`) pipelines.

**Behavior implemented (per spec):**
- Email is optional — a request without it still succeeds.
- When present, it must be a syntactically valid address; otherwise the request is rejected with **400**.
- A valid email is stored and returned **lower-cased**.

**Changes:**
- **`openapi.yml`** — added the optional `email` string property to the `OwnerFields` schema (so the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto` gain `email`, and MapStruct maps it automatically).
- **`Owner.java`** — added the `email` field with getter/setter and `@Column(name = "email")`.
- **DB schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added the `email` column to the `owners` table. Also gave the hsqldb `data.sql` owner inserts an explicit column list so the seed rows still load with the new nullable column.
- **`OwnerEmail.java`** (new helper) — `normalize()` returns `null` for absent/blank, validates syntax, throws `InvalidEmailException`, and lower-cases valid addresses.
- **`ValidateNewOwner.java`** (POST) and **`ValidateOwner.java`** (PUT) — normalize the email during validation.
- **`ApplyOwner.java`** (PUT) — applies the normalized email to the entity.
- **Escalation** — new checked `InvalidEmailException`, its `InvalidEmailExceptionHandler` (responds 400 with `{"errors":["email"]}`), and the matching `officefloor/escalation/...InvalidEmailException.yml`, mirroring the existing telephone-validation pattern.

I followed the OfficeFloor function-injection conventions from AGENTS.md rather than adding controllers or `@Transactional`.

Both create and update paths handle email, though the new acceptance tests exercise only the POST path.
